# Penelope Ling Hypnotherapy

> Solution-focused hypnotherapy practice in Oxford offering evidence-based treatment for anxiety, phobias, sleep issues, and behavioral change using hypnotherapy, NLP, BWRT, and mindfulness techniques.

Penelope Ling is an award-winning hypnotherapist practicing since 2007 at the Kingsmoor Clinic in Kingston Bagpuize, Oxfordshire, with online therapy available via Zoom. The practice specializes in solution-focused approaches to mental health conditions and life challenges.

## Phobia & Fear Treatment

- [Amaxophobia fear of driving - Penelope Ling Hypnotherapy](https://www.oxford-hypnotherapy.co.uk/problems/phobias/amaxophobia): Driving anxiety treatment using solution-focused hypnotherapy and NLP
- [Fear of Flying - Penelope Ling Hypnotherapy](https://www.oxford-hypnotherapy.co.uk/problems/phobias/fear-of-flying): Flight anxiety relief through hypnosis, NLP, and breathing techniques
- [Phagophobia - Penelope Ling Hypnotherapy](https://www.oxford-hypnotherapy.co.uk/problems/phobias/phagophobia): Treatment for phagophobia (fear of swallowing) with case studies
